description: Read the current published forecast for a supported highway, optionally scoped to a state, province or town. Includes now, 3, 6, 12 and 24 hour readings and official road-condition service links. This does not report road closures. Returns text and structured data without a card, suitable for scheduled or background checks and summaries. The paired get_highway_weather_interactive tool also displays an interactive forecast card.

highway.description: The highway as the user named it, such as I-80 or Trans-Canada Highway.

intent.description: Optional. In 15–25 words, the general purpose of this request, in the third person. Never include names, places, dates or other details from the conversation.

region.description: A state, province or city to narrow a long highway to its stretches there.

name: get_highway_weather
title: Weather along a highway
